sla.rule: If projected active execution exceeds 3h, increase sharding/bulk extraction/dedup/parallel synthesis; never weaken coverage to hit the clock.

combined_progress.formula: completed_atomic_obligations / frozen_total_atomic_obligations across all source and fusion obligations
combined_progress.rule: Do not claim >0 exact Level-0 coverage before frozen obligations exist.

historical_earned_work.rule: Replace this temporary retention prior with evidence-mapped reusable/avoided current-work equivalents during Level 0.

eta.basis: Parallel inventory/hash/dedupe/extraction/sharding/analysis/write-back pipeline; <=3h active wall-clock is a hard execution constraint.

666-00-DUAL-INDEX.goal: Recursively inventory Drive and Project-Frankenstein in parallel; freeze exact manifests/hashes.

666-01-DEDUPE-SHARD.goal: Hash, duplicate/version cluster, classify and create parallel semantic shards.

666-02-BULK-EXTRACT.goal: Bulk extract full relevant content by source class instead of serial manual reading.

666-03-PARALLEL-ANALYZE.goal: Analyze mechanisms, experiments, measurements, successes, failures and lineage across independent shards.

666-04-EARNED-WORK-MAP.goal: Map historical FRANK/XENO/ClayCode/GWT work to current Clay 0.1 workstreams and avoided/reused current effort.

666-05-CROSS-SOURCE-RECONCILE.goal: Resolve duplicates, chronology, contradictions, supersession and ancestry across Drive and Project-Frankenstein.

666-06-BRANCH-FEEDBACK.goal: Return material findings or NO_CHANGE receipts to all research branches and Q12 index.

666-07-AUDIT.goal: Verify exact coverage, earned-work mapping, hashes and PASS decision.
